subject.title: fix(tts): defer text settlement for final-mode TTS to eliminate churn (#83511)

question: Should `captionedFinalText` become a public channel plugin capability and be enabled by default for Telegram final-mode TTS?
rationale: The capability changes existing Telegram presentation and lets third-party plugins suppress user-visible text, so implementation correctness alone cannot establish the intended permanent plugin contract or bundled default.

options.title: Approve after repair
options.body: Keep the typed capability and Telegram opt-in after exact-send attribution, compatibility coverage, documentation, and current-head proof are complete.

options.title: Keep it Telegram-internal
options.body: Solve the Telegram churn without adding a public plugin capability until more caption-capable channels need the contract.

options.title: Retain separate delivery
options.body: Decline bundled caption deferral and leave separate text-plus-voice behavior until a user-selectable delivery policy is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the typed capability and Telegram opt-in after exact-send attribution, compatibility coverage, documentation, and current-head proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: The core TTS and current dispatch/channel-contract history most strongly routes the permanent API and Telegram-default decision to steipete.
